# icons

## Plugin reference

- Description: Contributes the prototypes icon family (prototypesIcons) to Icons.Family, so a scope whose iconFamily is prototypes — the Prototypes theme's — draws its glyphs.
- Web:
  - Contributes: `Icons.Family` "Prototypes"
  - Uses: `ui/icons.Icons`
- Core:
  - Uses: `ui/icons.defineIconFamily`
  - Exports (types): `PrototypesGlyph`
  - Exports (values): `prototypesIcons`
